Author: koko
Name: Raid Planner
Punchline: Record a fight, then make it a plan on Koko's Raid Planner.
Description:
Records the fights you're in: the boss's casts and where they land, stacks, spreads, tankbusters, tethers, head markers and waymarks, and (if you like) where your party stood. Send a pull to Koko's Raid Planner and it becomes a plan, step by step, ready to draw your strats on, or save it as a file to import there.

It only watches: nothing is sent to the game. Open it with /raidplan.
